text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board. This report recommends one candidate for appointment to the board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the Leaside Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on September 25, 2028, and until successors are appointed: - Edmund Chan 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 6, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena.
